project_title: Vitaminų ir papildų vartojimo laiko planuoklis (5op.lt)
design_archetype: Organic & Earthy + High-Precision Clinical Biohacking (Light Theme with Subtle Gradients)

theme.surface_cards: bg-white/80 backdrop-blur-md border border-emerald-900/10 shadow-sm shadow-emerald-900/5

typography.body_font: Plus Jakarta Sans, Inter, system-ui, sans-serif

hierarchy.h1_hero: text-3xl sm:text-4xl lg:text-5xl font-extrabold tracking-tight text-slate-900 leading-tight
hierarchy.eyebrow_badge: text-xs uppercase tracking-widest font-semibold text-teal-700 bg-teal-50 px-3 py-1 rounded-full border border-teal-200

layout_and_spacing.page_container: max-w-7xl mx-auto px-4 sm:px-6 lg:px-8 py-8 sm:py-12 space-y-10 sm:space-y-14

key_components.name: Header
key_components.description: Sticky top bar with blurred light background, logo '5op.lt | Vitaminų ir papildų vartojimo Planuoklis', live status badge, and direct link to e-shop.
key_components.styles: sticky top-0 z-50 bg-white/85 backdrop-blur-md border-b border-slate-200/80 px-4 sm:px-8 py-3.5 flex items-center justify-between shadow-xs

key_components.name: LegalDisclaimerBannerTop
key_components.description: Prominent scientific & legal disclaimer banner placed near the top explaining educational nature, medical consultation need, and non-prescription guidance.
key_components.styles: bg-amber-50/80 border-l-4 border-amber-500 p-4 rounded-r-xl text-amber-900 text-sm flex gap-3 items-start leading-relaxed shadow-xs

key_components.name: UserProfileBlock
key_components.description: Interactive profile selector for Gender/Age category (Vyras, Moteris, Vaikas 6+) and digestive sensitivity toggle switch (Jautrus virškinimas).
key_components.styles: bg-white border border-slate-200 p-6 rounded-2xl shadow-sm space-y-4

key_components.name: SupplementSelectorCategories
key_components.description: Two structured categories of scientific supplements (1. Baziniai & Sveikatos palaikymo / 2. Biohacking & Veiklos optimizavimo) with checkboxes + dynamic dose badges, plus a custom supplement input field with add button.
key_components.styles: bg-white border border-slate-200 p-6 rounded-2xl shadow-sm space-y-6

key_components.name: DynamicScheduleTimeline
key_components.description: Time-blocked daily schedule cards (Rytas, Pietūs, Prieš treniruotę, Po treniruotės, Vakaras, Prieš miegą) with intake timing, calculated dosages, short PubMed rationale, and interactive 'Where to Buy / Partner Recommendation' card embedded in each timeline slot.

key_components.name: ScientificInteractionWarnings
key_components.description: Dynamic warning & synergy engine detecting interactions (e.g. Iron + Calcium competition, Zinc + Copper balance, Fat-soluble vitamins require meal, Caffeine timing conflict).
key_components.styles: bg-rose-50/70 border border-rose-200/80 p-5 rounded-2xl space-y-3

key_components.name: ExportAndShareActions
key_components.description: Toolbar to download personalized plan as PNG/PDF or copy shareable link with encoded URL state parameters.
key_components.styles: flex flex-wrap gap-3 items-center justify-between bg-slate-100/80 p-4 rounded-xl border border-slate-200

key_components.name: ScientificSourcesBlock
key_components.description: Accordion/Grid listing scientific literature, meta-analyses, PubMed links, and DOI references backing every supplement recommendation.
key_components.styles: bg-white border border-slate-200 p-6 rounded-2xl shadow-sm space-y-4

key_components.name: PartnerAdSidebarPlaceholders
key_components.description: Visually appealing placeholder cards for brand partners (e.g., '5op.lt Premium Omega-3', 'Magnesio Citratas High Absorption') with clear CTA buttons.
key_components.styles: bg-gradient-to-b from-teal-50/50 to-emerald-50/50 border border-teal-200/60 p-5 rounded-2xl text-center space-y-3 shadow-xs

key_components.name: Footer
key_components.description: Footer with repeated legal disclaimer, partnership email partneryste@5op.lt, quick navigation links, and bright primary CTA button 'Apsilankyti el. parduotuvėje 5op.lt' to https://5op.lt.
key_components.styles: bg-slate-900 text-slate-300 py-12 px-4 sm:px-8 space-y-8 rounded-t-3xl border-t border-slate-800

instructions_to_main_agent: Build the complete single-page application in Lithuanian for 5op.lt brand with full interactive state.
Implement profile selection (Vyras, Moteris, Vaikas 6+) and digestive sensitivity toggle with real-time recalculation of recommended daily dosages and intake schedules.

Include at least 10 popular supplements divided into 2 scientific categories (e.g. 1. Baziniai: Vitaminas D3+K2, Magnis, Omega-3, Geležis, Vitaminas C, B kompleksas; 2. Biohacking & Veiklos: Ashwagandha, Creatine, L-Theanine, Zinc + Copper, CoQ10) plus a working custom supplement input.

Display detailed daily timeline split into 6 clear time blocks (Rytas, Pietūs, Prieš treniruotę, Po treniruotės, Vakaras, Prieš miegą) with scientific timing, dose, stomach rules (su maistu / tuščiu skrandžiu), and short rationale.
Render partner product recommendations cards with link placeholders pointing to 5op.lt e-shop.
Provide PDF/PNG printable/downloadable summary view and Copy shareable link functionality using URL query search params.
Include scientific interaction warning alerts (e.g. alert when Iron and Calcium or Zinc and Magnesium are selected in conflicting time slots).
Render scientific references section with realistic PubMed links/DOIs.
Ensure all interactive elements have data-testid attributes.
Adhere strictly to light minimalist biohacking theme with high contrast readability and clean spacing.
UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT: Avoid centered text body layouts; keep content left-aligned for natural reading.
Use layered subtle shadows and crisp 1px borders for clean depth.
Never use generic AI emojis like 🤖 or 💡 inside icons; use Lucide-react or Phosphor icons.
Ensure total color contrast compliance (APCA/WCAG AA) against light backgrounds.
Ensure responsive design from 320px mobile up to 1440px+ ultra-wide screens.
